label.purpose: Sidebar group headers and small field labels.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards, dialogs and the floating player in light mode.

shadows.name: panel-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: The same lift in dark mode.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State changes on controls; no page-load choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen exists for.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action beside the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--panel); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Row
components.description: Leading icon, label, mint wash when current.
components.html: Songs
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted); font: 600 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav--active { background: var(--accent-dark); color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: A group of related rows; hairline border in flow, lift only when floating.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px; padding: 22px; } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 6px; font: 600 20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--text); } .ds-card__meta { margin: 0; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Raised fill, hairline border, mint focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent); }

narrative.overview: A calm room built for one activity: listening. Surfaces are quiet and slightly warm, the mint accent appears only where an action or a selection lives, and nothing on the screen competes with the music. The room is layered rather than flat: panels sit above the page on soft shadows, the player floats at the bottom, and the sidebar is its own plane.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (harbor mint) for primary action, selection and live state only.
Layered planes: page, panel, raised control, floating player.
Inter at a small, tight scale; labels in uppercase micro-caps for grouping.
Rounded, quiet controls (7-14px) with pill shapes reserved for chips and status.
Legible in dark, light and the app's own Default look.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Harbor Mint is used for the primary action, the current selection and live state. Everything else is neutral; if two things on a screen are mint, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Quiet Scale Rule
rules.body: Type grows in small steps (11 -> 14 -> 20 -> 25px). A new size is a new decision; prefer weight and colour to inventing a size.

rules.name: The Floating Player Rule
rules.body: Only the player and true overlays float. A list row or a card in the page flow gets a hairline border, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Harbor Mint to one primary action, the current selection and live state.
Do use the panel/raised pair for hierarchy instead of new colours.
Do give every control default, hover, focus, active, disabled and error states.
Do show a hairline border on in-flow cards and the panel lift on floating ones.
Do write empty states that invite the next action.
Do use tabular numerals for durations, counts and byte sizes.
donts: Don't nest a card inside a card, or stack two shadows.
Don't put an uppercase kicker above a heading.
Don't use gradient text, glass, blur, decorative motion or page-load choreography.
Don't use emoji, Unicode glyphs or monospace as icons.
Don't introduce a second accent colour, a second type family or a new radius step without deciding it here first.
